name: Demonstration Designer
author: Brett
description: Pitch the product in three picks and one button. Pick a plugin, screen or UI element from the live registry, pick a length in minutes, pick a narrator voice, press Generate: the designer writes a pitch script with zero tokens (a hook up front, benefits instead of specs, a closing call to action), picks the best screens, and plays a polished demo on the console's real data with a spotlight on each control, smooth zooms and pans, captions, soft background music and a logo intro and outro. Afterwards tweak the words, preview again, export the recording as a video (MP4 when the server has ffmpeg, WebM otherwise) or copy a share link that opens and plays it. Demos are demonstration@1 assets (reusable, chainable into tours, indexed by the glossary); recordings are clip@1 assets. Advanced work (a step timeline, record a demo by doing it) stays folded away. Every action and setting is also on REST, the MCP tools demonstration_designer_*, `axf demonstration-designer …` and the voice actions pitch.*; the deep link ?axf-demo=<id> opens it.

items.title: What can be pitched
items.description: Every plugin, screen and UI element the repo registers, with the plain words a pitch is written from; q filters by words, kind by plugin, screen or ui-element.
items.output: { items: [{ id, kind, label, description, screens }] }

items.title: List pitch demos
items.description: Every saved demo with its steps, running time, topic, narrator, chain and recordings.

items.title: One pitch demo
items.description: The demonstration@1 asset of a demo plus its pitch facts (minutes, topic, product, call to action, plan).

items.title: Generate a pitch
items.description: Write the pitch script of a topic with zero tokens: a hook, the best screens with highlighted controls, a call to action, fitted to the minutes asked for, in the narrator voice given; saved unless save is false.

topic.description: a registry id: plugin:ui-review, screen:home, ui-element:console-web:x

voice.description: narrator voice name, blank = device default, silent = captions only

items.title: Save a pitch demo
items.description: Store a demo (an asset@1 object with demonstration@1 data and optional pitch facts), validated and normalised.

items.title: Delete a pitch demo
items.description: Remove a demo; its recordings stay as clips.

items.title: The script as text
items.description: The demo's words as plain text: one block per step, a '# Title' line then what the narrator says.

items.title: Apply a tweaked script
items.description: The text (blocks split on blank lines) becomes the steps' words; each block keeps the action and target of the step at its position.

items.title: Chain demos into a tour
items.description: Set the demos that play after this one; an empty list clears the chain.

items.title: The demo as walkthrough@1
items.description: The demo and its chain as one playable walkthrough@1 (steps of say, do, target).

items.title: Share link
items.description: The deep link that opens the designer on this demo, and the one that plays it at once (?axf-demo=<id>&axf-autoplay=1).

items.title: Designer settings
items.description: Every setting: script (minutes, product, call to action, pace), narration (voice, speed, captions), stage (zoom, highlight, controls, logo), music (on, volume, mood), export (format, transcode, keep) and advanced.

items.title: Change a setting
items.description: Change settings: { section: { key: value } } or { key: 'music.volume', value: 12 }. Unknown keys are dropped; values are clamped.

items.title: List recordings
items.description: Every recording kept as a clip@1: the demo it shows, its file, seconds and whether an MP4 exists.
items.output: { items: [{ id, name, demo, video, seconds, recordedAt, mp4 }] }

items.title: Upload a recording
items.description: Raw video bytes of a recording the stage made (query: id, seconds, mime); kept under media/, registered as a clip, transcoded to MP4 when ffmpeg is on the server and the export setting says so.

items.title: One recording file
items.description: The video file of a recording by its name under media/.

items.title: Export a recording as MP4
items.description: Transcode a recording (clip id) to MP4 with the server's ffmpeg; answers with an error naming the gap when there is none.
